measurement_notes: Release, 960x540, 1x DPI, processes pinned to logical CPU 0. 3 runs per phase, each containing 3 trials with 60 warmup and 120 measured ticks.
Other workspace builds existed on this shared host during the session. No own compilation or snapshot run overlapped the reported benchmark runs.
The 60 nonidentical history screenshots differ at real wall-clock labels. 180 display, input and skin-preview screenshots are pixel identical.
